title: fix: keep npm installs below shipped updater limits
body:
## What Problem This Solves

Package Acceptance's npm12 install reached 47,898 entries, above the unchanged 47,500 guard and approaching the immutable 50,000-entry cap in already-published updaters. This candidate installs at **41,793 entries** on Linux, below the requested 46,500 target with **5,707 entries of guard headroom**.

## User Impact

Mistral chat continues to use the pinned 2.7.0 SDK through the existing AI runtime. No provider version, configuration, schema, public API, guard, or updater cap changes. Required workers, updater compatibility bridges, and documentation remain packaged.

## Design

Bundle the reachable Mistral chat-client code into `@openclaw/ai`, replacing the standalone runtime SDK dependency with a build dependency. Keep its runtime transitives external, preserve its optional OpenTelemetry peers, and ship the Apache-2.0 license. Production advisory traversal includes the bundled SDK and its dependency closure. The dependency-ownership audit records the bundled telemetry consumer, which a direct-source-import scan cannot see.

## Installed-tree evidence

Package Acceptance [run 39014861449](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/actions/runs/39014861449), npm12 job 117347449156, passed on runtime head `05fdc67009ed`. The final follow-up `ce3bed2864f` changes only the ownership checker and its test.

| npm12 global install | Failed package `8fad2ad5befd` | Candidate | Delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| Linux CI entries | 47,898 | 41,793 | -6,105 |
| macOS independent reproduction | 47,899 | 41,794 | -6,105 |

Both use the unmodified installed-package checker, including the root, directories, symlinks, and npm's hidden lockfile. Detailed macOS directory comparison:

| Directory | Before | After | Delta |
| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: |
| `node_modules/@mistralai/mistralai` | 6,386 | 0 | -6,386 |
| Empty `node_modules/@mistralai` scope | 1 | 0 | -1 |
| `node_modules/@openclaw/ai` | 129 | 132 | +3 |
| Root `dist` files | 9,265 | 9,265 | 0 |
| `dist/control-ui` | 1,983 | 1,974 | -9 |
| `dist/extensions` | 1,370 | 1,370 | 0 |
| `dist/state` | 169 | 178 | +9 |
| `docs` | 1,439 | 1,439 | 0 |
| New MCP client/server/core/node packages | 0 | 212 | +212 |
| `parse5` | 0 | 40 | +40 |
| `@hono/node-server` | 32 | 59 | +27 |

The Mistral cut saves **6,384 entries** after the AI bundle's three-entry increase. Other changes integrated from main add 279 entries. Linux candidate size is 592.6 MiB, below the unchanged 900 MiB guard; total byte comparisons span those unrelated MCP additions. The SDK cut itself removes 10.62 MiB and adds 0.18 MiB to AI.

Growth since the last green Package Acceptance (`48199cc25305`, 47,494 entries) was chiefly root `dist` +270 entries (ordinary modules +207, tiny façades +66), Control UI +62, and extensions +20. The 451 historical updater bridges were unchanged. Generated runtime modules and UI variants remain the continuing growth sources; source maps were already excluded.

## Validation and known failures

- Actual AI build streams a synthetic Mistral SSE response through the public runtime while rejecting external SDK imports: pass (one test; Vitest 2.58 s, wrapper 4.62 s).
- Artifact inspection: 43 declaration files, no external Mistral SDK type references, Apache license present. Downloaded candidate checksum verified against CI metadata.
- Four worker/bootstrap files: 52 tests passed. The complete 14-file worker E2E inventory finished with 18 tests passed and one launch-wire test timed out at 240 seconds. Its focused candidate replay also timed out; the baseline passed in 225.3 seconds. This is an unresolved candidate-only timeout on the loaded local host, not an inherited failure or a claimed fix. No behavioral assertion failed in that case; no latency conclusion is drawn.
- Published-driver × candidate update cell: passed; the complete Package Acceptance workflow is green (9 successful jobs).
- Final-head CI passed formatting, type-aware lint, source contracts, production/test types, ownership boundaries and baseline ratchets (168 successful jobs, 22 skipped).
- Final CI has three inherited behavioral failures, shown below. The selected Telegram head replay passed, but that is not a claimed repair. Known failures and the local worker timeout are recorded for their owners. Landing uses the authorized relaxed workflow; the aggregate CI gate remains red.
- Knip: all 20 production and 13 full-tree findings empirically match the completed canonical scan on main `8fc3509a66ad`; scanner/config blobs match. No candidate-only findings and no scripts findings.

| Final CI failure | Observed main/base evidence |
| --- | --- |
| Telegram young session-start conflict, line 1072: follower `802` missing while `801` remains pending | Same assertion and queue contents on pinned base `7de7f398b4e9`; candidate selected-case replay passed. |
| QA terminal delivery, line 409: expected lowercase `no_reply`, received no delivery | Exact failure on both pinned base `7de7f398b4e9` and candidate. |
| Memory shadow-cache bound: `primary cache overflow`, SQLite 1811 | Exact case reproduced on main `ec430f5cd126`; all seven relevant test/owner files match candidate and base. |

Focused comparison ran through the repository test wrapper on Node 24.22.0, using the same test selection on candidate and base. The wrapper stopped after E2E failures, so the memory result reuses the independently completed main run rather than claiming it ran in that wrapper invocation. The local worker timeout remains a validation gap; it is separate from the three inherited CI failures.

No SQL owner changed. Touched-area Gateway T1: **0 → 0**. Statements/requests and removed-check edge cases are not applicable; no SQL or latency improvement is claimed.

Two independent Codex review rounds completed: implementation clean through P2; manifest/test repair scoped-clean for P0/P1. Change size: 11 files, 324 insertions / 18 deletions, largely generated lockfile, package metadata, and artifact/audit regressions. Provider implementation code is unchanged.
